notes: Evidence gaps: no archivable primary source found for the 2021 round (led by Earlybird, per the Series B text) or the 2022 Series A, nor for the seed; amounts not evidenced so no events written (WebSearch budget exhausted, newsroom only lists releases from 2023). Series B first close: b2venture (an investor) and TechCrunch list different investor sets (TechCrunch: Bayern Kapital, Tengelmann, SPRIND; b2venture: Athos, Primepulse, Plural, Earlybird, b2venture); both are recorded as participants, none with own amounts. TechCrunch dated 2024-09-25 PDT, b2venture 2024-09-26. EIC Accelerator: "blended finance option of up to EUR 17.5M" (grant 2.5M + up to 15M equity) is an option, not a completed event; the grant part is recorded from CORDIS (EUR 2,489,221.49); the EIC Fund share of the 2025 extension is undisclosed. EIC STEP Scale Up (release 2025-11-19): selected to due diligence for a PROSPECTIVE equity investment of up to EUR 30M; not recorded as funding. FusioTile: ~EUR 11M BMFTR funding is the consortium total (Marvel, Zeiss Jena, Fraunhofer IOF, TU Ilmenau, Lenstec), Marvel's share undisclosed, so amount omitted. BMFTR Laser Fusion Hub (2026-07-29): amount not stated in the release (hub is co-led with Focused Energy); DOE RISE hub ($16M to the hub, CSU/SLAC lead, Marvel a partner) not recorded as Marvel funding. SPRIND funded the first two laser prototypes via Pulsed Light Technologies (no amount or date found). The 2025-03-27 release claims EUR 385M total funding (EUR 170M private, EUR 215M public cooperation projects), recorded as cumulative only. SPRIND Series B participation rests on press only. CORDIS bulk and BODACC not used; only the allowed project fact-sheet page was archived. VERIFIER (2026-10-05): Series B first close (EUR 62.8M, Sept 2024) and extension (EUR 50M, Mar 2025) are real tranches of one round (company: total round EUR 113M, i.e. 62.8 + 50 rounded), so both stay new_money in round_group series-b; the EIC Fund equity sits inside the EUR 50M extension (TechCrunch: the EIC equity "if made will be an extension of this round") and must not be added again. The DOE INFUSE award is delivered "in partnership with Colorado State University": INFUSE money normally goes to the partner institution, not the company, so even if an amount is found it should not count as Marvel funding without a source naming Marvel as recipient.
